summary: ServiceCode class and associated methods manage service codes, including listing all service codes and options by CourseID or TimetableID, with localization support.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service codes for various purposes in the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: RetrieveServiceCodes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all service codes.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with CourseID to retrieve service codes for a specific course.
